name: The Cursed Crew
label: Quest
description: First Mate Fitzsimmons, the sole living survivor of the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, asks for mercy on behalf of his lost brethren. Trapped by a dark relic…
intro: First Mate Fitzsimmons, the sole living survivor of the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, asks for mercy on behalf of his lost brethren. Trapped by a dark relic hidden aboard their sunken ships off the Wetlands coast, the drowned sailors and marines wander the wrecks as restless undead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.
But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.

clips.title: Progress
paras: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good friend, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My thanks to you, friend. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
